name: molecular_simulations
description: Build an AMBER system (tleap, OPC explicit water) and run the OpenMM MD pipeline (minimize/heat/equilibrate/NPT production) with the molecular-simulations package on Aurora XPU via platform='OpenCL'; one row per system, returns prmtop/inpcrd + eq/prod DCDs.
_timeout_note: 7200s default is a placeholder. Smoke build+sim on 1L2Y (heat/equil 1000, prod 2000) was ~44s; a REAL production run uses the package defaults (heat 100k, equil 1.25M, prod 250M @ ~385 ns/day) and takes many hours — far beyond one EL task. Either set reduced *_steps per row, or rely on Simulator.run() resuming from prod.rst.chk across successive timed tasks.
_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md §5). GPU platform is 'OpenCL' (NOT CUDA); device is the single ZE_AFFINITY_MASK-visible tile. AMBERHOME must be set (runner does so worker-side from site['molecular_simulations']['amberhome']). VERIFIED path = pipeline='explicit' (ExplicitSolvent + Simulator). TODO(verify): pipeline='implicit' (documented, not exercised) and pipeline='complex'/'ligand' (needs rdkit+openbabel, which the SKILL.md says are NOT installed -> expect ImportError). The example 1L2Y.pdb path is illustrative (SKILL.md ran a curl'd copy); confirm a worker-visible PDB before use.
_example_todo_verify: confirm the tests/data/pdb/1L2Y.pdb path exists on the worker, or point 'pdb' at a PDB you own.
